metadata.title: residue-apn: coefficient choice in Galois-ring lifts of APN permutations (paper, Lean 4 formalization, blueprint, finite computations)

creators.name: Fukui, Hiroki
creators.affiliation: Research Institute of Criminal Psychiatry / Sex Offender Medical Center, Tokyo, Japan; Department of Neuropsychiatry, Kyoto University, Kyoto, Japan

metadata.description:
Package for the paper "Coefficient choice in Galois-ring lifts of APN permutations: sharp unit-direction spectra and one-term optimal lifts" (paper version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23683495). It contains the paper source and PDF, the blueprint of the formalization with its generator, the Lean 4 development (Lean 4.31.0-rc1, Mathlib d568c8c; 55 modules; 150 audited declarations, each depending only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; no sorry) and the finite computations with replay scripts and negative controls. First command on a copy: python3 release/verify_published.py (expected PUBLISHED_CHECK=PASS); guide REPRODUCE.md.

Version 2.0.0 is built around a new, substantially revised and extended paper; the material of versions 1.0.x remains in those versions.

Licences: MIT for code and machine-readable files; CC BY 4.0 for prose by the author (paper source and PDF, blueprint, Markdown); per-file licence in release/DISTRIBUTION_FILES.tsv.

Version 2.0.1 corrects the release documents of 2.0.0 (licence notice, manifest script, supplement README, CHANGELOG, TRUST); the paper, the blueprint, the Lean sources and the computations are unchanged. The paper cites version 2.0.0 (doi 10.5281/zenodo.23683493), which stays available.

Status: Version 2.0.1 (software version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23684624; source repository https://github.com/hirokifukui/residue-apn, tag v2.0.1).
